note: Derived batch program for every remaining schema-census entry and the original mutation-scope statements. Program applyNow stays false. A mutation batch sets applyNow only when the live scan no longer counts every source statement in that batch, and the baseline file then shrinks to that scan. This file does not remove a census entry. Hold batches do not shrink either ratchet. Do not edit the mutation scanner or the route-coverage scanner to change a count. Do not regenerate a baseline except to record statements the live scan no longer counts. Finance issuance stays fail-closed. services/financial-service is not an approval path.

batches.action: Before any financial-service job is mounted, put the job tenant into the WHERE of each flagged update. dues_transactions uses eq(organizationId, tenantId) with the tenantId argument, not the id just loaded. payments and notification_queue declare tenantId; call inOrganization(row.tenantId, callerTenantId), implemented as equality on that column. The caller tenant comes from the job argument. Do not copy the tenant off the row loaded by the same id. Do not insert an unused organization identifier to satisfy the scanner. Do not issue a financial mandate. services/financial-service is not an approval path. Do not edit the mutation scanner.

clc_sync_log is TENANT_RLS_REQUIRED and is served by the organization-scoped routes app/api/clc/sync, app/api/clc/dashboard and app/api/clc/remittances. The partnership service has no caller organization and no production, dynamic, or worker importer. It must not insert or update that table. Django ClcSyncLogViewSet still names the relation and is not changed here. Do not drop the relation. Do not edit the mutation scanner.

The rebind compares verifiedOrganizationId with the previous organization. The scanner ignores comments when it measures the distance to .where( and when it reads the predicate, so a comment cannot hide that predicate and cannot supply an organization token. Whitespace between statements still counts. The compare-and-set is unchanged.

A workbook has no organization until it is claimed. The Stripe fulfilment update and the claim update require claimedByUserId to be null beside the existing credential guards. Fulfilment still requires a null payment reference and a null claim token. Claim still requires the single-use token, a null claimedAt, and an unexpired token, and writes the organization returned for the authenticated user. In-process PGlite proves one of two serialized transactions wins and the other caller organization is not stored. Native two-session proof stays READY_FOR_VS_EXECUTION. Do not invent an organization column.

Each retention delete names the owning userId and expiresAt. The sweep reads the expired owners, deletes that user's expired rows, and writes one deletion log in the same transaction. A runtime session cannot see another member's rows, so complete coverage still requires the system role. In-process PGlite proves both members' expired rows go, live rows stay, and a failed log rolls the deletes back. Native combined-schema proof stays READY_FOR_VS_EXECUTION.

Delete the Drizzle declaration and the schema-folder relations that only name it. Do not DROP the database relation. Do not hand-delete the census row. The census shrinks only when VS Code regenerates it with UE_CENSUS_WRITE=1 on a disposable database after the declaration is gone.
The registry class is live and the reference scan finds no production file. Retire the Drizzle declaration only. Do not DROP the live relation and do not hand-delete the census row.

No keys and no RLS from that generator. Generate SQL only for this list, review it, and commit it as the next platform migration. Do not apply it here. VS Code proves the shrink on a disposable database.
